single-leg-press.name: Single-leg leg press
single-leg-press.howTo: Set one foot in the middle of the platform and release the safeties. Lower until your knee is bent to about 90 degrees without your hip lifting off the pad, then press back up. Switch legs.

leg-press-calf.name: Calf press on leg press
leg-press-calf.howTo: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform and your knees straight but not locked. Let your heels drop back, then push through the balls of your feet. Keep the safeties engaged.

narrow-machine-squat.name: Narrow-stance machine squat
narrow-machine-squat.howTo: Stand on the platform with your feet hip-width apart and your back flat against the pad. Lower until your thighs are about level, keeping your heels down, then stand.

single-leg-extension.name: Single-leg leg extension
single-leg-extension.howTo: Set the pad just above one ankle. Straighten that knee fully, pause, then lower slowly. Do all reps, then switch legs.

single-leg-curl.name: Single-leg lying leg curl
single-leg-curl.howTo: Lie face down with one ankle under the pad and your hips pressed into the bench. Curl your heel toward your glutes, then lower slowly. Switch legs.

single-leg-hip-thrust.name: Single-leg hip thrust
single-leg-hip-thrust.howTo: Set up as for the hip thrust with one foot on the platform and the other leg lifted. Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knee, pause, then lower. Switch legs.

glute-kickback-machine.name: Machine glute kickback
glute-kickback-machine.howTo: Brace your forearms on the pads and place one foot against the footplate. Push it back and up by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back, then return slowly. Switch legs.

hip-abduction.name: Hip abduction
hip-abduction.howTo: Sit with your back on the pad and the pads on the outside of your knees. Push your knees apart as far as is comfortable, pause, then bring them back slowly.

hip-abduction-lean.name: Hip abduction, leaning forward
hip-abduction-lean.howTo: Set up as for hip abduction, then lean your chest forward over your thighs. Push your knees apart and return slowly; the lean shifts more of the work to your glutes.

hip-adduction.name: Hip adduction
hip-adduction.howTo: Sit with the pads on the inside of your knees, starting at a width that feels comfortable. Squeeze your knees together, pause, then let them open slowly.

calf-extension-machine.name: Machine calf extension
calf-extension-machine.howTo: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and your legs nearly straight. Push the platform away with your toes as far as you can, pause, then let your heels come back for a full stretch.

glute-ham-raise.name: Glute-ham raise
glute-ham-raise.howTo: Lock your ankles under the rollers with your knees just behind the pad. Lower your body forward under control, then pull yourself back up with your hamstrings, keeping your hips straight. Use your hands to help as needed.

assisted-nordic-curl.name: Assisted Nordic curl
assisted-nordic-curl.howTo: Kneel with your ankles locked under the rollers. Lean forward as slowly as you can with your body straight, catch yourself with your hands, and push back up. Stop if you feel sharp pain behind the knee.

back-extension.name: Back extension
back-extension.howTo: Set the pad just below your hip bones and lock your ankles in. Lower your upper body until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then rise until your body is straight, without arching past it.

glute-back-extension.name: Glute-focused back extension
glute-back-extension.howTo: Set up as for the back extension with your feet turned out and your upper back rounded slightly. Lift by squeezing your glutes, stopping when your body is straight.

smith-squat.name: Smith machine squat
smith-squat.howTo: Stand with the bar across your upper back and your feet slightly in front of the bar. Unhook it, sit down until your thighs are about level, then stand. Set the safety stops just below your lowest point.

smith-split-squat.name: Smith machine split squat
smith-split-squat.howTo: With the bar on your upper back, take a long step forward with one foot. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push through your front heel to rise. Do all reps, then switch legs.

smith-rdl.name: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
smith-rdl.howTo: Hold the bar at your hips with your knees slightly bent. Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs until you feel your hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.

smith-bench.name: Smith machine bench press
smith-bench.howTo: Lie on a flat bench with the bar over your mid-chest. Unhook it, lower it to your chest with control, then press it back up. Set the safety stops just above your chest.

smith-incline-press.name: Smith machine incline press
smith-incline-press.howTo: Set an incline bench under the bar so it lines up with your upper chest. Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up. Set the safety stops just above your chest.

smith-shoulder-press.name: Smith machine shoulder press
smith-shoulder-press.howTo: Sit on an upright bench with the bar just in front of your face. Press it overhead until your arms are straight, then lower it to chin height.

smith-inverted-row.name: Smith machine inverted row
smith-inverted-row.howTo: Set the bar at about waist height and hang under it with your body straight and heels on the floor. Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower. Raise the bar to make it easier.

smith-calf-raise.name: Smith machine calf raise
smith-calf-raise.howTo: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and the bar on your upper back. Lower your heels for a stretch, then rise as high as you can.

smith-hip-thrust.name: Smith machine hip thrust
smith-hip-thrust.howTo: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips. Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, pause, then lower.

single-arm-machine-press.name: Single-arm machine chest press
single-arm-machine-press.howTo: Sit with the handles at mid-chest height. Press one handle forward until your arm is straight, then return slowly. Do all reps, then switch arms.

decline-machine-press.name: Decline machine press
decline-machine-press.howTo: Sit with your back on the pad and the handles in line with your lower chest. Press forward and down until your arms are straight, then return slowly.

machine-shoulder-press.name: Machine shoulder press
machine-shoulder-press.howTo: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height. Press overhead until your arms are straight, then lower slowly.

pec-deck.name: Pec deck fly
pec-deck.howTo: Sit with the handles at chest height and a slight bend in your elbows. Bring the handles together in front of you, squeeze, then open slowly until you feel a stretch.

machine-lateral-raise.name: Machine lateral raise
machine-lateral-raise.howTo: Sit with the pads on the outside of your upper arms. Raise your elbows out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

close-grip-pulldown.name: Close-grip pulldown
close-grip-pulldown.howTo: Attach a close-grip handle and sit with your thighs under the pad. Pull the handle to your upper chest, leading with your elbows, then let your arms straighten slowly.

neutral-pulldown.name: Neutral-grip pulldown
neutral-pulldown.howTo: Hold the handles with your palms facing each other. Pull them down to your upper chest, then let your arms straighten slowly.

single-arm-pulldown.name: Single-arm pulldown
single-arm-pulldown.howTo: Hold one handle with your arm straight overhead. Pull your elbow down toward your side, then let it rise slowly. Do all reps, then switch arms.

machine-high-row.name: Machine high row
machine-high-row.howTo: Sit with your chest against the pad and reach up and forward to the handles. Pull them down and back toward your ribs, then return slowly.

single-arm-machine-row.name: Single-arm machine row
single-arm-machine-row.howTo: Sit with your chest against the pad and hold one handle. Pull your elbow back past your side, then let your arm straighten slowly. Switch arms.

machine-curl.name: Machine biceps curl
machine-curl.howTo: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the machine’s pivot. Curl the handles up, then lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

machine-preacher-curl.name: Machine preacher curl
machine-preacher-curl.howTo: Rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad. Curl the handles up, then lower slowly without letting your elbows lift.

seated-triceps-press.name: Seated triceps press
seated-triceps-press.howTo: Sit tall with your hands on the handles at your sides. Push down until your arms are straight, then let them rise slowly.

machine-crunch.name: Machine crunch
machine-crunch.howTo: Sit with your feet secured and hold the handles. Curl your chest toward your hips by tightening your abs, then return slowly.

low-high-fly.name: Low-to-high cable fly
low-high-fly.howTo: Set both pulleys low. With a slight bend in your elbows, sweep the handles up and together to chest height, then lower slowly.

high-low-fly.name: High-to-low cable fly
high-low-fly.howTo: Set both pulleys high and step forward. Sweep the handles down and together in front of your hips, then return slowly.

cable-curl.name: Cable curl
cable-curl.howTo: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar or rope. Curl it up, keeping your elbows at your sides, then lower slowly.

rope-hammer-curl.name: Rope hammer curl
rope-hammer-curl.howTo: Hold a rope on a low pulley with your palms facing each other. Curl it up, keeping your elbows at your sides, then lower slowly.

single-arm-pushdown.name: Single-arm pushdown
single-arm-pushdown.howTo: Hold a handle from a high pulley with one hand. Push down until your arm is straight, keeping your elbow at your side, then let it rise. Switch arms.

cable-lateral-raise.name: Cable lateral raise
cable-lateral-raise.howTo: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the far hand. Raise your arm out to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Switch sides.

cable-reverse-fly.name: Cable reverse fly
cable-reverse-fly.howTo: Stand between two pulleys set at shoulder height, holding the opposite handles with your arms crossed. Sweep your arms out and back, then return slowly.

pallof-press.name: Pallof press
pallof-press.howTo: Stand side-on to a chest-height pulley holding the handle at your chest. Press it straight out and hold, resisting the pull, then bring it back. Switch sides.

cable-woodchop.name: Cable woodchop
cable-woodchop.howTo: Stand side-on to a high pulley and hold the handle with both hands. Pull it down and across your body to the opposite hip, turning through your torso, then return slowly. Switch sides.

cable-pull-through.name: Cable pull-through
cable-pull-through.howTo: Face away from a low pulley with a rope between your legs. Push your hips back with a flat back, then stand by squeezing your glutes.

cable-kickback.name: Cable glute kickback
cable-kickback.howTo: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and face it, holding the frame. Push your leg back by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back, then return. Switch legs.

single-arm-cable-row.name: Single-arm cable row
single-arm-cable-row.howTo: Hold a handle from a chest-height pulley with one hand. Pull your elbow back past your side, then let your arm straighten slowly. Switch arms.

straight-arm-pulldown.name: Straight-arm pulldown
straight-arm-pulldown.howTo: Face a high pulley holding a bar or rope with straight arms. Sweep it down to your thighs, then let it rise slowly.

cable-rdl.name: Cable Romanian deadlift
cable-rdl.howTo: Face a low pulley holding the handles. Push your hips back with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.

cable-split-squat.name: Cable split squat
cable-split-squat.howTo: Hold the handles from low pulleys and take a long step forward. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push through your front heel to rise. Switch legs.

incline-bb-press.name: Incline barbell press
incline-bb-press.howTo: Lie on the incline bench with your eyes under the bar. Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up. Use a spotter or safety arms.

decline-bb-press.name: Decline barbell press
decline-bb-press.howTo: Lock your legs in and lie back with the bar over your lower chest. Lower it to your lower chest, then press it back up. Use a spotter.

seated-bb-ohp.name: Seated barbell overhead press
seated-bb-ohp.howTo: Sit upright with the bar at shoulder height. Press it overhead until your arms are straight, then lower it to your upper chest.

front-squat.name: Barbell front squat
front-squat.howTo: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high. Sit down until your thighs are about level, keeping your chest up, then stand. Use a rack with safety arms.

bb-hip-thrust.name: Barbell hip thrust
bb-hip-thrust.howTo: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips. Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, pause, then lower.

close-grip-bench.name: Close-grip bench press
close-grip-bench.howTo: Lie on a flat bench and hold the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart. Lower it to your lower chest with your elbows close to your sides, then press it back up. Use a spotter or safety arms.

bb-curl.name: Barbell curl
bb-curl.howTo: Stand holding the bar with your palms facing up. Curl it to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides, then lower slowly.

bb-shrug.name: Barbell shrug
bb-shrug.howTo: Hold the bar at your thighs with straight arms. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, then lower.

db-incline-fly.name: Incline dumbbell fly
db-incline-fly.howTo: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells above your chest and a slight bend in your elbows. Open your arms until you feel a stretch, then bring them back together.

db-decline-press.name: Decline dumbbell press
db-decline-press.howTo: Lock your legs in on the decline bench with dumbbells above your lower chest. Lower them to the sides of your chest, then press back up.

db-row.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
db-row.howTo: Put one hand and knee on a flat bench with your back flat. Pull the dumbbell to your hip, then lower it until your arm is straight. Switch arms.

db-step-up.name: Dumbbell step-up
db-step-up.howTo: Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot on a box or bench. Push through that heel to stand on top, then step down with control. Switch legs.

walking-lunge.name: Walking lunge
walking-lunge.howTo: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor, then step through into the next lunge.

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian-split-squat.howTo: Stand a stride in front of a bench with your back foot on it, holding dumbbells. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push through your front heel to rise. Switch legs.

arnold-press.name: Arnold press
arnold-press.howTo: Sit holding dumbbells at chin height with your palms facing you. Press up while turning your palms forward, then reverse on the way down.

db-front-raise.name: Dumbbell front raise
db-front-raise.howTo: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs. Raise them straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

incline-db-curl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
incline-db-curl.howTo: Lie back on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight. Curl the dumbbells up without moving your elbows forward, then lower slowly.

db-skull-crusher.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
db-skull-crusher.howTo: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other. Bend your elbows to lower them beside your head, then straighten your arms.

db-pullover.name: Dumbbell pullover
db-pullover.howTo: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with both hands. Lower it back over your head with slightly bent elbows until you feel a stretch, then bring it back.

db-shrug.name: Dumbbell shrug
db-shrug.howTo: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, then lower.

farmer-carry.name: Farmer’s carry
farmer-carry.howTo: Pick up heavy dumbbells and stand tall. Walk with short, steady steps for the set distance or time, then set them down with your back flat.

kb-swing.name: Kettlebell swing
kb-swing.howTo: Stand with the kettlebell in both hands between your feet. Hike it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height. Let it fall back and repeat; your arms only guide it.

kb-deadlift.name: Kettlebell deadlift
kb-deadlift.howTo: Stand over the kettlebell with your feet hip-width apart. Push your hips back, grip the handle with your back flat, then stand tall.

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase carry
suitcase-carry.howTo: Hold one heavy kettlebell at your side and stand tall without leaning. Walk for the set distance or time, then switch hands.

turkish-get-up.name: Turkish get-up
turkish-get-up.howTo: Lie on your back holding a light kettlebell straight up. Keeping your eyes on it and your arm locked, rise step by step to standing, then reverse to the floor. Learn it with no weight first.

side-plank.name: Side plank
side-plank.howTo: Lie on your side propped on your forearm, with your elbow under your shoulder. Lift your hips so your body is straight and hold. Switch sides.

bird-dog.name: Bird dog
bird-dog.howTo: Start on your hands and knees. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level, pause, then return. Alternate sides.

push-up.name: Push-up
push-up.howTo: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders. Lower your chest toward the floor with your body straight, then push back up. Put your hands on a bench to make it easier.

glute-bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute-bridge.howTo: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat. Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes, pause, then lower.

bench-dip.name: Bench dip
bench-dip.howTo: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands beside your hips, then slide off. Bend your elbows to lower your body, then press back up.

chin-up.name: Chin-up
chin-up.howTo: Hang from the bar with your palms facing you. Pull until your chin is over the bar, then lower until your arms are straight. Use an assisted machine or a band if needed.

dip.name: Parallel bar dip
dip.howTo: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms. Lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows, then press back up.

hanging-leg-raise.name: Hanging leg raise
hanging-leg-raise.howTo: Hang from a bar. Raise your straight legs to hip height without swinging, then lower slowly.

incline-walk.name: Incline treadmill walk
incline-walk.howTo: Set the treadmill to a steady incline and walk without holding the rails. Keep a pace where you could hold a conversation.

treadmill-run.name: Treadmill run
treadmill-run.howTo: Walk for a few minutes first, then run at a steady pace you can keep for the set time.

rower.name: Rowing machine
rower.howTo: Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs. Reverse the order on the way back.

elliptical.name: Elliptical
elliptical.howTo: Stand tall and move at a steady pace using both the handles and the pedals. Set the resistance so you can still hold a conversation.

stair-climber.name: Stair climber
stair-climber.howTo: Step at a steady pace with your whole foot on each step, holding the rails only lightly for balance.

ladder-climber.name: Ladder climber
ladder-climber.howTo: Climb with your hands and feet at a steady pace, keeping your hips close to the ladder. Start with short intervals.

lying-leg-curl.name: Lying leg curl
lying-leg-curl.howTo: Lie face down with your knees just off the edge of the bench and the pad above your heels. Curl your heels toward your glutes with your hips pressed into the bench, pause, then lower slowly.

machine-row.name: Seated machine row
machine-row.howTo: Sit with your chest against the pad and hold both handles with your arms straight. Pull your elbows back past your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then let your arms straighten slowly.

cable-chest-press.name: Cable chest press
cable-chest-press.howTo: Sit or stand with your back to the pulleys and the handles at chest height. Press both handles forward until your arms are straight, then bring them back slowly until your hands are level with your chest.

cable-shoulder-press.name: Cable shoulder press
cable-shoulder-press.howTo: Sit or stand with the handles at shoulder height and your palms facing forward. Press them overhead until your arms are straight, then lower them to shoulder height.

cable-lift.name: Cable lift
cable-lift.howTo: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle with both hands at your near hip. Sweep it up and across your body to above the opposite shoulder, turning through your torso, then return slowly. Switch sides.

cable-step-up.name: Cable step-up
cable-step-up.howTo: Face the low pulleys holding a handle in each hand, with one foot on the step. Push through that heel to stand tall on the step, then lower with control. Do all reps, then switch legs.

machine-squat.name: Machine squat
machine-squat.howTo: Stand with your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width apart. Sit down until your thighs are about level, keeping your heels down and your chest up, then stand.

machine-triceps-extension.name: Machine triceps extension
machine-triceps-extension.howTo: Sit with your upper arms on the pad and your elbows in line with the machine’s pivot. Straighten your arms fully, pause, then let the handles return slowly.

machine-hip-thrust.name: Machine hip thrust
machine-hip-thrust.howTo: Sit with your upper back against the pad, the belt or pad across your hips and your feet flat on the platform. Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, pause, then lower.

machine-hip-extension.name: Machine hip extension
machine-hip-extension.howTo: Set the pad behind one thigh or ankle and hold the handles. Push that leg back by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back, then return slowly. Switch legs.

decline-sit-up.name: Decline sit-up
decline-sit-up.howTo: Hook your feet under the pads of the decline bench and cross your arms over your chest. Curl up until your chest nears your thighs, then lower slowly without dropping.

machines.pull-up: Pull-up bar or assisted pull-up machine
